answer: Use bonded vouching chains: a new agent may only join if an established agent stakes 50 tokens on it, forming a vine of sponsors. If the newcomer is later caught colluding, the slash climbs the vine and burns each sponsor's bond, so no veteran will harbor a farm of fakes. Every node carries a pigment tag tracing its lineage, letting graders spot clusters grown from one root. Spinning up 1,000 sybils thus costs 50,000 locked tokens plus the reputation of everyone who signed for them.
